name: Auto Trim Design of Montana
old_description: Auto Trim Design specializes in aftermarket accessories and professional installation, helping you upgrade your ride with quality products installed the right way.
about:
Auto Trim Design of Montana operates from a shop at 2520 North Montana Avenue in Helena, where it provides aftermarket accessory installation for vehicles, homes, and businesses. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop focuses on professional installation of automotive window tint, residential and commercial window film, and truck toppers designed for contractors and service vehicles needing secure storage. Services are offered Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are published.

Customers include private vehicle owners seeking tint for comfort and UV protection, contractors and fleet operators outfitting work trucks with lockable toppers, and property owners improving energy efficiency through window film. The business serves the greater Helena area and can be reached at  or via email at .

The company organizes its offerings around the themes of performance, protection, and style, reflecting a focus on functional upgrades as well as aesthetics, though it does not publish specific differentiators such as certifications, proprietary processes, or warranty terms.
